plan.question: Does decision-relevant temporal value increase with curriculum level, independent of partition identity?

stage3f.rule: Stage 3G reads these; it never rewrites a Stage 3F artifact, certificate, hash, fact, the Decision Evaluation Contract, authority or the expert roster. A Stage 3G result that bears on a frozen fact is reported as new Stage 3G evidence, never as an edit of the fact.

hypotheses.H1_LEVEL_SCALING: multi-step temporal value increases with curriculum level
hypotheses.H2_THRESHOLD_EFFECT: temporal value becomes material only above a complexity threshold
hypotheses.H3_PARTITION_ARTIFACT: the Stage 3G.3 OOD gain is partition-specific, not a level effect
hypotheses.H4_RETREAT_LEVEL_INTERACTION: the retreat residual becomes more temporal / option-dependent at higher levels
hypotheses.H5_NO_STABLE_TEMPORAL_EFFECT: temporal gains do not replicate after level balancing

plan.frozenDiagnostics: ONE_STEP, H2, H3, H4, privileged OPTION and BEST_CAPACITY exactly as Stage 3G.3 (definitions, rollout semantics, scalarisation, materiality, label-leak guard, fitted weights)

columns.definition: in-bounds, traversable, unblocked 4-neighbours of the destination (the MOVEs open at t+1)
of those, neighbours that are not hazard terrain and not Manhattan-adjacent to an in-service visible hostile
max over open neighbours of (distance to nearest in-service hostile) minus that distance at the destination; 0 with no hostile
in-bounds 4-neighbours of the destination (4 minus adjacent grid edges)
1 if the destination is ENVIRONMENTAL_HAZARD terrain
open neighbours of the destination that are not hazard terrain (hazard escape options)

boundedSearch.definition: exhaustive known-model search: candidate immediate scalar + max cumulative FORGE_REWARD_V2 scalar over all sequences of d further legal symmetric-surface actions; PRIVILEGED

reused.rule: refitted deterministically on the Stage 3G.3 DEV rows; each must reproduce its Stage 3G.3 model hash (the Stage 3G.3 fitted models, byte for byte)

planners.PLANNER_D0: argmax over candidates of search[0] (immediate scalar), uniform over ties; no fitting
planners.PLANNER_D3: argmax of search[3], depth-3 subsample only

primary.primaryHorizon: H3 (the best Stage 3G.3 horizon); H2 and H4 reported and eligible for the transition rule

secondary.role: SECONDARY: separates level scaling from level-0/1 extrapolation; never decides a primary conclusion

plan.provenance: Stage 3G.3 reserved 5022-5023 (HOLDOUT) and 5032-5033 (OOD) "for later Stage 3G"; Stage 3G.4 re-declares 5022 and 5032 as seed families covering every level, so partition identity = seed family, crossed with level. 6011 is a new open fit seed.
plan.exclusion: reject any record, world or topology hash claimed by the 80,000-row Stage 3F lineage, the 12,000 Stage 3G.1/3G.2 sealed rows, the 12,000 Stage 3G.3 sealed rows, the fit set (for sealed rows), or earlier admissions
plan.admission: P.1D benchmark-bound corpusRecord; for each (seed, level, horizon band) cell, combinations in canonical objectives > roles > shape order until the quota is admitted; every 25th candidate carries D4 evidence
plan.depth3Subsample: every 16th eligible row of each sealed partition (in stored order)

rules.MATERIAL: difference >= 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, normalised regret not worse (the frozen materialGain rule)
rules.PARTIAL: a D_Hk / D_SEARCH / PLANNER comparison at total depth k uses only rows with label horizon h where h + 1 > k (Stage 3G.3 label-leak guard)
rules.PER_LEVEL: descriptive, independent bootstrap CIs per level per family and pooled
rules.SLOPE: primary trend statistic: n-weighted least-squares slope over levels 0-7 of the pooled (both families) per-level gain D_H3 - NEW_LINEAR on PARTIAL_3 rows; 95% CI from 2000 deterministic bootstrap resamples drawn within each level

SCALING.MONOTONICALLY_INCREASES: slope CI lower bound > 0 and pooled band gains LOW <= MID <= HIGH
SCALING.HAS_THRESHOLD: some band is MATERIAL in both families while every lower band is not; THRESHOLD = the lowest such band
SCALING.IS_NON_MONOTONIC: some band is MATERIAL in both families while a higher band is not, or the pooled band gains are not ordered and the slope CI contains 0
SCALING.IS_LEVEL_INDEPENDENT: slope CI contains 0 and the pooled band gains lie within 0.02 of each other

rules.PARTITION_EFFECT: family A - family B difference in the primary gain (unpaired bootstrap CI), per level, at HIGH, and pooled over levels; MATERIAL if |difference| >= 0.05 and the CI excludes 0. LEVEL_EFFECT_MEASURED = slope estimated with a CI; PARTITION_EFFECT_MEASURED = the family difference estimated at every level (the design crosses family with level, so both are identified)
rules.H3_PARTITION_ARTIFACT: the HIGH-band gain is MATERIAL in family B and not in family A, or the pooled / HIGH partition effect is MATERIAL
rules.H4_RETREAT_LEVEL_INTERACTION: the bootstrap slope over levels of the retreat-optimal temporal gain (D_H3 - NEW_LINEAR on retreat-optimal PARTIAL_3 rows) or of the retreat-optimal privileged option gain has a CI lower bound > 0
rules.H5_NO_STABLE_TEMPORAL_EFFECT: no band has D_H3 - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL in both families
rules.TRANSITION_PREDICTION_NOW_JUSTIFIED: exists k in {2,3,4} with ALL of: (1) D_Hk - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL on PARTIAL_k rows in MID and HIGH (2) in both families (3) partition effect of D_Hk not MATERIAL at HIGH nor pooled (4) every integrity check = 1 (5) D_Hk - D_OBS_OPTION MATERIAL in MID and HIGH in both families (6) relative regret reduction >= 0.20 with normalised-regret difference CI upper bound < 0, in MID and HIGH in both families
rules.OBSERVABLE_OPTION_FEATURES_SUFFICIENT: in every (MID/HIGH, family) cell where some D_Hk - NEW_LINEAR is MATERIAL, D_Hk - D_OBS_OPTION is not MATERIAL; false if D_OBS_OPTION captures none of them; NOT_TESTABLE when no such cell exists
rules.DETERMINISTIC_BOUNDED_SEARCH_SUFFICIENT: in every (MID/HIGH, family) cell where D_H2 or D_H3 - NEW_LINEAR is MATERIAL, D_H2 - D_SEARCH_D1 (resp. D_H3 - D_SEARCH_D2) is not MATERIAL; NOT_TESTABLE when no such cell exists. PLANNER_D0..D3 reported alongside (D3 on the subsample)
rules.WORLD_MODEL_WORK_NOW_JUSTIFIED: TRANSITION_PREDICTION_NOW_JUSTIFIED and OBSERVABLE_OPTION_FEATURES_SUFFICIENT is not true and DETERMINISTIC_BOUNDED_SEARCH_SUFFICIENT is not true
rules.TEMPORAL_VALUE_MATERIAL_MID_LEVEL: some k: D_Hk - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL on PARTIAL_k MID rows in both families
rules.TEMPORAL_VALUE_REPLICATED: some band has D_H3 - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL in both families
rules.PARTITION_CONFOUND_RESOLVED: LEVEL_EFFECT_MEASURED and PARTITION_EFFECT_MEASURED (identification, whatever the sign)
rules.ORACLE_CRITICAL_PATH: answered as: does the evidence put temporal modelling on the critical path? true only if TRANSITION_PREDICTION_NOW_JUSTIFIED

plan.dryRun: certify.mjs --dry-run --out=<path outside the repository> runs every code path with the open fit rows standing in for the sealed families (alternate rows -> A / B, so every level is exercised in both); no sealed row is read; required before the sealed run; never writes a tracked file
plan.amendmentProcess: a harness-only defect after the sealed run is fixed by a disclosed amendment binding the certifier's before/after bytes; if the first run produced a certificate its scientific sections must be reproduced exactly
